subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode add a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft and checklist state while sending the final answer separately, or should the current one-line collapse summary remain the supported policy?
rationale: The requested behavior adds new public Telegram streaming config and changes the finalization lifecycle beyond the current collapse-summary implementation, so automation cannot infer the intended product contract safely.

options.title: Accept Default-Off Full-Draft Preservation
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned option that keeps current behavior as the default while preserving the completed draft and checklist state when explicitly enabled.

options.title: Keep The Collapse Summary
options.body: Decline full-draft preservation for now and treat the current final answer plus one-line activity digest as the supported Telegram progress completion UX.

options.title: Defer To Structured Progress Cards
options.body: Pause the Telegram-only key and design a cross-channel structured progress-card API before committing to checklist semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-Off Full-Draft Preservation
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned option that keeps current behavior as the default while preserving the completed draft and checklist state when explicitly enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the current collapse-summary implementation and tests that a keep-on-complete option would extend or replace.
